outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic domain map and western blot images, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel B shows bar charts of % HTT FT depletion and log2 HTT elution abundance vs. mIgG per antibody; these appear to be quantifications derived from western blot densitometry (likely averaged/single measurements per antibody) with no individual replicate data points overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a heatmap, which is exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Panel D is a violin plot, which already displays the full data distribution and is exempt from this check.
Panel E is a bar chart (mean ± SD, n=4) with individual replicate data points overlaid as circles on each bar.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot, where individual points are inherently the data being displayed.
Panel H is a scatterplot showing individual IP-MS experiment values, exempt from this check.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot, exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Panel J is a PCA scatterplot (repeated across tissues), exempt from the individual data point requirement.
